props.name: resource
props.description: What the reader tried to open — "Q3 board deck".

props.name: resourceType
props.description: What kind of thing it is, for the sentence — "document", "project".

props.name: onRequestAccess
props.description: Sends the request. Return a promise to show it pending; a rejection shows its message. Omit to hide the button.

props.name: requestStatus
props.description: Controlled request status — pass sent when a request already exists.

props.name: account
props.description: The account the reader is signed in with.

props.name: onSwitchAccount
props.description: Called when switching account is chosen, for an app that handles it in place.
